notes: The margin's 'Or, appointed' was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

The supplied subject 'he' of 'he wrought' is placed on the infinitive under rules 48 and 52; giving it instead to the finite hirbah, whose person and number it realizes under rule 17, was the materially competing reading.
'them that had familiar spirits' is one recasting of the single noun 'ob under rule 46's closing paragraph, headed on 'spirits' rather than on 'had'.
